user.title: Connect to the monitoring
user.description: In the monitoring app, open your account menu (top right) > **Jetons d'accès (Home Assistant)**, create a token and paste it here.

data_description.token: Starts with mon_. It can only read probe states and re-run probes.

hassio_confirm.title: Monitoring (add-on)
hassio_confirm.description: The Monitoring add-on is running on this Home Assistant. Do you want to add its probes as entities? No address or token needed.

reauth_confirm.title: New access token
reauth_confirm.description: The token used for {url} is no longer accepted (it was probably deleted). Create a new one in the monitoring app and paste it here.

reconfigure.title: Change the connection
reconfigure.description: Useful if the monitoring IP address changed. Leave the token empty to keep the current one.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the monitoring at this address. Check the IP, port (8080) and that the service is running.
error.invalid_auth: Token rejected: check it was copied completely and has not been deleted.
error.not_monitoring: This address does not answer like the monitoring app, or the app needs an update (version 2.1 or newer).
error.unknown: Unexpected error, check the Home Assistant logs.

abort.already_configured: This monitoring is already configured (its address and token were updated).
abort.wrong_instance: This address belongs to a different monitoring instance.
abort.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the Monitoring add-on: check that it is started.
abort.invalid_auth: The token provided by the add-on was rejected: restart the add-on.
abort.not_monitoring: The Monitoring add-on needs to be updated.
abort.unknown: Unexpected error, check the Home Assistant logs.

data.mail_preview: Show sender and subject of latest mails

data_description.scan_interval: How often (in seconds) Home Assistant reads the probe states (probes keep their own schedule in the monitoring app).
data_description.mail_preview: Adds a “derniers_mails” attribute to unread mail sensors (never stored in history).
data_description.panel: Add-on only: shows the monitoring at the short address /monitoring and hides the add-on's own sidebar entry so it doesn't appear twice.

problems.name: Probes with a warning or error

invalid_auth.message: The monitoring access token was rejected.

action_failed.message: The monitoring could not run the action: {error}
